info.name: JFrog Artifactory Docker Registry API
info.description:
Docker Registry HTTP API V2 implementation in JFrog Artifactory. Provides endpoints for managing Docker images including pushing and pulling layers and manifests, listing tags, and managing repositories. Artifactory acts as a fully compliant Docker registry with additional features like promotion and property management.

Contact Support:
 Name: JFrog Support
 Email: support@jfrog.com
